main_body: Snow-roofed stone well: snow-covered roof on two wooden posts, a stone well body with a dark water opening, and a banded stone front
top_band: Snow roof, white and pale blue, rows 1-8, with a front edge and icicles at rows 8-10. The well's own top is the dark opening ellipse at rows 17-22, framed by a grey stone rim.
evidence: Down the middle column the snow roof is a broad light horizontal surface (rows 1-8) that ends in a lighter front edge and icicles. Below it the back stone wall and rope show between the posts, then the opening is drawn as a dark ellipse with water and a bucket (rows 17-22), then a stone front face with dark mortar bands (rows 24-30). The opening reads as an inset ellipse that can be seen into, as in the roofed-well reference. The stone rim around the opening is thin, but the opening itself reads clearly as a surface seen from above.

style.evidence: The snow has about 4-5 tones (white, pale blue, blue-grey), with icicles and wood posts in 3-4 browns. The stone back wall has checker and brick texture. Outlines lean brown or blue-grey rather than pure black. The lower stone front is built from fairly flat horizontal bands, so it is slightly sparser than the reference well. Overall it holds up next to the reference.
